title: 도시철도법 등에 의한 구분지상권 등기규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:03005:20211029:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM <Supreme Court Rule No. 3005, October 29, 2021>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on December 16, 2021: Provided, That the amended provisions concerning Article 10-3 of the Sewerage Act shall enter into force on January 6, 2022.

Article 2 (Applicability)
The amended provisions concerning Article 6-4 of the Electric Power Source Development Promotion Act shall apply beginning with cases in which an electric power source development business entity applies for registration of sectional superficies on or after December 16, 2021, including cases in which an adjudication of expropriation or use concerning sectional superficies under that Act was completed on or before December 15, 2021, but registration had not yet been completed.
